title: Coordinating an AI partnership and technology workstreams
summary: Coordinated stakeholders, technology requirements and vendor workstreams for a government-facing AI initiative in Hong Kong.
context: The proposed initiative involved public service requirements, a technology partner and workstreams covering hardware, cloud and software.
decisions: I translated service requirements into technical specifications, coordinated the strategic memorandum with the technology partner and negotiated vendor contracts for compute and platform workstreams.
outcome: The work produced a strategic memorandum, project requirements and an R&D coordination workstream. The initiative was later discontinued.
